tests.prompt: Provision category 'cli-launch' and three draft posts: slugs 'cli-alpha', 'cli-beta', 'cli-gamma', titles 'Alpha & Omega', 'Beta: a "quoted" title', and 'Gamma, revised'. Each post must have that category and '_cli_synced=yes'. Update matching existing posts while preserving their other metadata and categories. Preserve unrelated content. The script runs twice; create no duplicates.
requirements: Use native WP-CLI commands for WordPress operations; discover IDs rather than assuming them.
tests.expected_behavior: The script satisfies these observable contracts: Provisioning converges on exactly three correctly configured posts without duplicates. Unrelated fixtures remain intact.
tests.reference_solution:
set -e
if ! wp term get category cli-launch --by=slug >/dev/null 2>&1; then wp term create category cli-launch --slug=cli-launch; fi
while IFS='|' read -r slug title; do
  id=$(wp post list --post_type=post --post_status=any --fields=ID,post_name --format=json | jq -r --arg slug "$slug" ' .[] | select(.post_name==$slug) | .ID')
  if [ -z "$id" ]; then id=$(wp post create --post_type=post --post_name="$slug" --post_status=draft --post_title="$title" --porcelain); else wp post update "$id" --post_status=draft --post_title="$title" >/dev/null; fi
  wp post term add "$id" category cli-launch --by=slug
  wp post meta update "$id" _cli_synced yes
done <<'POSTS'
cli-alpha|Alpha & Omega
cli-beta|Beta: a "quoted" title
cli-gamma|Gamma, revised
POSTS
exploit_solutions: wp term create category cli-launch; wp post create --post_name=cli-alpha --post_title='Alpha & Omega' --post_status=draft

tests.prompt: Prepare a deletion preview without changing data. Select trashed posts marked '_cli_cleanup=yes' dated before 2020-01-01, excluding posts whose '_legal_hold' is 'yes'. Print only CSV with header 'ID,post_title', actual numeric IDs in ascending order, and correctly escaped titles. Include no pages, recent trash, or unmarked posts.
requirements: Use native WP-CLI commands for WordPress operations; discover IDs rather than assuming them.
tests.expected_behavior: The script satisfies these observable contracts: The CSV preview contains only eligible records with correct escaping and order; Preview leaves all posts and pages unchanged. Unrelated fixtures remain intact.
tests.reference_solution:
set -e
candidates=$(wp post list --post_type=post --post_status=trash --meta_key=_cli_cleanup --meta_value=yes --fields=ID,post_date --format=json | jq -r '.[] | select(.post_date < "2020-01-01") | .ID')
ids=''
for id in $candidates; do
  hold=$(wp post meta get "$id" _legal_hold 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ "$hold" != yes ]; then ids="${ids:+$ids,}$id"; fi
done
if [ -n "$ids" ]; then wp post list --post_type=post --post_status=trash --post__in="$ids" --orderby=ID --order=ASC --fields=ID,post_title --format=csv; else printf 'ID,post_title\n'; fi
